description.value: The Lung Duck Tong Restaurant is a heritage building within Barkerville Historic Town & Park, a National Historic Site in BC's Cariboo region that preserves more than 125 Gold Rush-era structures along a historic streetscape. Barkerville brings the 1860s gold rush to life with costumed interpreters, working museums, and period shops set amid forests and mountains. For a touring cyclist, it represents a rare immersive step back into BC's frontier history in a remote but well-developed heritage destination.
